neighbours.label: the token ' antigen' (also as the stem of antigenic / antigenically); other immunology words (antibody, allergen) stay quiet
fire: Each flu season the surface antigen of the virus changes slightly.
The rapid test detects a viral antigen in a nasal swab.
Dendritic cells carry the antigen to nearby lymph nodes.
The new strain is antigenically similar to last year's virus.
Doctors ordered a prostate-specific antigen test for the patient.
B cells recognize an antigen through receptors on their surface.
The researchers purified the antigen before injecting it into mice.
Blood type depends on which antigen sits on the red cells.
